Subject: Discrepancies on Nov marketplace invoices (AWS + GCP)

Hi Olga,

We received November invoices and noticed two items that don't match our internal metering:

- AWS Marketplace: a $27,430 charge marked as "Marketplace resale" that we don't see in our usage reports.
- GCP Marketplace: VAT line of EUR 3,200 appears on the settlement but our legal entity is VAT-exempt under the reverse charge (we shared VAT cert in July).

I'm attaching the PDF of our invoice and our note on the lines we dispute. Can you help reconcile and advise what Redwood's expected credit/offset process looks like? Our finance team is trying to close the month and needs a timeline.

Attachments: acme_nov_invoice_11-2026.pdf (pdf, 214KB)

Thanks,

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancies on Nov marketplace invoices (AWS + GCP)

Hi Lara — thanks for flagging this and for the attachments. I pulled the invoice and our raw meter logs and here's what I see so far:

- AWS line: Looks like a marketplace resale aggregation charge for a short-lived burst in Region us-west-2 on 11/17. We're querying AWS for the per-hour metering report to validate buyer and product id; I raised Ticket AWS-Ticket-#123456789 (CC'd below).
- GCP VAT: We have your VAT certificate on file, but GCP's settlement pipeline sometimes applies local VAT until a manual tax offset is issued. I'll escalate to GCP billing (we'll ask them to reverse the VAT and issue a credit to avoid double taxation).

Proposed next steps (timeline):
1) Today (11/25): I’ll collect and share the AWS per-sku usage CSV and the GCP settlement snapshot (internal).
2) By 11/30: Coordinate a credit/offset plan with AWS and GCP — aim for credits to appear on December invoices.
3) By 12/07: If credits aren't issued, Redwood will propose an interim internal offset and send a reconciliation memo to Acme for your records.

I’m attaching our initial analysis sheet (redwood_marketplace_analysis_202611.xlsx) with the lines we want AWS/GCP to validate. Marcus, Marissa — can you confirm the recommended offset approach below? Neha, FYI on VAT handling.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

From: aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, accounts@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AWS-Ticket-#123456789: Marketplace metering detail for 11/17 burst

Hello Olga and Lara,

Thanks for the report. We investigated Ticket AWS-Ticket-#123456789 and can confirm a resale aggregation record on 2026-11-17 18:00 UTC for product ID com.redwood.prod-rt-1 that resulted in the $27,430 settlement line. Per our logs, the consuming account was acct-ACME-9981 and usage stamps show a 45-minute spike tied to a scheduled batch job.

We can:
- Provide a detailed per-minute CSV (attached: aws_usage_report-202611.csv).
- Issue a credit for the portion that ACME indicates is outside agreed entitlements if you provide the buyer-side PO and an affirmative confirmation from Acme's finance contact.

Please note: AWS marketplace credits are applied as negative settlement lines and generally appear on the next billing cycle; in some cases they are held until the next payout.

Ticket: AWS-Ticket-#123456789
Attachments: aws_usage_report-202611.csv (csv, 1.2MB)

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Billing Support
aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com

Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 09:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace billing: proposed credit offset schedule & VAT triage

Thanks for the AWS confirmation and the CSV. Quick internal note and ask:

- Marcus: propose we request a partial credit from AWS for the 11/17 spike (approx $22.5k) and Redwood will absorb the disputed remainder if AWS denies the buyer-side PO match. That keeps Acme whole while we chase collection. Approve?
- Marissa/Finance: if AWS issues credit only in mid-Dec, can Redwood perform a December internal offset to Acme's account so their month close isn't delayed? We'll track as contra-revenue and reverse once AWS posts the credit.
- Neha: GCP VAT — can you confirm we have Acme's VAT cert on file and prepare the VAT offset request to GCP with the reverse-charge reference? If GCP requires a signed attestation from Acme, Olivia (cc) please advise.

Suggested public timeline for Acme (replying-all):
- 12/01–12/04: Confirm buyer PO evidence and sign attestation (Acme)
- 12/07: Redwood issues interim offset on Acme's account (if AWS/GCP credits not visible)
- 12/15: Target for AWS/GCP final credits to post (subject to provider processing)

Olga
